bio: This contemporary-looking bistro is located in Novi Beograd, the modern business and shopping district across the Sava River from Belgrade’s city centre. The menu shines the spotlight on seasonal produce and changes throughout the year depending on market availability. In addition to a concise lineup of daily specials announced at your table, you can order a tasting menu flanked by an insightful wine pairing options (one of the owners, youthful Vuk Vuletić, is an award-winning sommelier)....
